description: Retired couple filing jointly, both over 65, with Social Security, a pension, interest, qualified dividends and a long-term gain: taxable Social Security in the 85% band below the cap, each senior deduction partly phased out, and the gains stacked on ordinary income across the 0% and 15% bands.
